text: President Trump shared an AI image on Truth Social Friday night of him, Vice President JD Vance, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and Secretary of the Interior Doug Burgum wading in the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.
translated_text: 特朗普总统在周五晚上的 Truth Social 上分享了一张人工智能图像，照片中他、副总统 JD 万斯、国务卿马可·卢比奥和内政部长道格·布尔古姆在林肯纪念堂倒影池中涉水。

text:
Crews with the National Park Service have been coating the bottom of the drained pool with "American flag blue" paint. Swimming or wading in the landmark is prohibited, according to the NPS.

President Trump said the renovation project will take a week and cost $2 million.
translated_text:
国家公园管理局的工作人员已经在排干的水池底部涂上“美国国旗蓝”油漆。根据 NPS 的规定，禁止在该地标内游泳或涉水。

特朗普总统表示，翻修工程将耗时一周，耗资 200 万美元。

text:
Guido is still on top of the Frederick Douglas bridge in DC this morning. 

He’s been there since yesterday. 

He’s protesting the war in Iran and the rise of AI. 

My only question, well I have a ton, but how does he keep a charge?!
translated_text:
今天早上，吉多仍在华盛顿特区的弗雷德里克·道格拉斯大桥上。 

他从昨天就一直在那儿。 

他抗议伊朗战争和人工智能的崛起。 

我唯一的问题是，我有很多钱，但他如何保持费用？
